enabled.description: Enable or disable the Discord integration. Requires a bot token and at least one channel ID.

botToken.description: Discord bot token. Keep this secret; it is never shown in the dashboard or written to logs.

guildId.description: Discord guild (server) ID. Messages from other guilds are ignored.

chatChannelId.description: Channel ID used for the Minecraft chat relay in both directions.

moderationChannelId.description: Optional channel ID for moderation notifications. Empty falls back to the chat channel.

notificationChannelId.description: Optional channel ID for server/player/restart notifications. Empty falls back to the chat channel.

serverChannelId.description: Optional channel ID for server start/stop and restart messages. Empty falls back to the notification channel.

deathsChannelId.description: Optional channel ID for death messages. Empty falls back to the notification channel.

advancementsChannelId.description: Optional channel ID for advancement messages. Empty falls back to the notification channel.

commandLogChannelId.description: Channel ID for the command log. Empty disables the command log entirely; unlike the other channels this never falls back, so an unset ID can never leak executed commands into public chat.

minecraftToDiscordEnabled.description: Relay public Minecraft chat into the Discord chat channel. Staff and group chat are never relayed.

discordToMinecraftEnabled.description: Relay messages from the Discord chat channel into Minecraft chat.

allowOtherBots.description: Relay messages authored by other Discord bots. Paradigm's own messages are always ignored.

allowDiscordMentions.description: Allow Minecraft players to ping Discord users and roles. Disabled means mentions are rendered as text only.

showAttachments.description: Render attachments, embeds and stickers from Discord messages as clickable links and extra lines under the relayed Minecraft message.

discordRoleColorIngame.description: Color the author's name in-game using their highest colored Discord role.

discordChatFormat.description: Discord-side chat format. Discord markdown in this template is preserved; relayed player text is escaped. Feature tokens: {player}, {message}. Paradigm player placeholders such as {prefix}, {suffix} and {group} also work.

minecraftChatFormat.description: Minecraft-side chat format for relayed Discord messages. Supports the same TAG formatting as chat.customChatFormat, for example <color:aqua>text</color> and <bold>text</bold>. Tokens: {name}, {message}.

webhookEnabled.description: Relay player chat through a channel webhook so each message shows the player's own name and skin instead of the bot identity. Requires the Manage Webhooks permission in the chat channel. Note that the avatar URL below sends player names or UUIDs to a third-party skin service.

webhookName.description: Name of the webhook Paradigm creates and reuses. Paradigm only adopts a webhook that it owns, so a webhook created by someone else with this name is never touched.

webhookPlayerAvatarUrl.description: Avatar image URL used for relayed player chat in webhook mode. Tokens: %name%, %uuid%, %uuid_dashless%, %randomUUID%.

allowWebhookMessages.description: Relay messages posted by other webhooks into Minecraft. Paradigm's own webhook is always ignored.

presenceEnabled.description: Show a bot status such as the online player count in Discord.

presenceType.description: Bot status type: custom, playing, watching, listening or competing.

presenceUpdateSeconds.description: How often the bot status is refreshed, in seconds. Discord only allows a few presence updates per minute, and unchanged statuses are never re-sent.

presenceFormatSingular.description: Bot status text used when exactly one player is online. Empty uses presenceFormat.

presenceFormatEmpty.description: Bot status text used when nobody is online. Empty uses presenceFormat.

notifyPlayerDeath.description: Send a Discord message when a player dies.

deathFormat.description: Discord message for player deaths. Feature tokens: {player}, {message}.

notifyAdvancement.description: Send a Discord message when a player earns an advancement that Minecraft would announce to chat.

advancementFormat.description: Discord message for advancements. Feature tokens: {player}, {advancement}, {description}.

commandLogIgnoredCommands.description: Command roots that are not logged. Namespaces are ignored, so 'tell' also matches 'minecraft:tell'. Commands that can carry passwords or private messages are always excluded regardless of this list and of commandLogWhitelist.

commandLogWhitelist.description: Invert commandLogIgnoredCommands so that it becomes the only list of commands that are logged.

minecraftReplyFormat.description: Minecraft-side format for a Discord message that replies to another message. Supports the same TAG formatting as minecraftChatFormat. Tokens: {name}, {message}, {reply_name}, {reply_message}.

notifyDiscordEdits.description: Relay it to Minecraft as a new line when a relayed Discord message is edited. Minecraft cannot edit a line that was already sent.

minecraftEditFormat.description: Minecraft-side format for an edited Discord message. Supports the same TAG formatting as minecraftChatFormat. Tokens: {name}, {message}.

notifyDiscordDeletes.description: Relay it to Minecraft when a relayed Discord message is deleted. The original content is never shown again, only that it was deleted.

minecraftDeleteFormat.description: Minecraft-side format shown when a relayed Discord message is deleted. Tokens: {name}.

serverStartedFormat.description: Discord message sent when the server has finished starting.

serverStoppingFormat.description: Discord message sent when the server begins shutting down.

playerJoinFormat.description: Discord message for player joins. Feature tokens: {player}, {online}, {max}.

playerLeaveFormat.description: Discord message for player leaves. Feature tokens: {player}, {online}, {max}.

moderationFormat.description: Discord message for moderation actions. Feature tokens: {icon}, {action}, {target}, {actor}, {reason}, {duration}, {duration_suffix}, {punishment_id}, {expiry}.

restartScheduledFormat.description: Discord message when a restart sequence starts. Feature tokens: {time}, {seconds}.

restartCancelledFormat.description: Discord message when a scheduled restart is cancelled.

restartCountdownFormat.description: Discord message for restart countdown warnings. Feature tokens: {time}, {seconds}.

restartImminentFormat.description: Discord message sent immediately before the server restarts.

notifyServerStarted.description: Send a Discord notification when the server has started.

notifyServerStopping.description: Send a Discord notification when the server is stopping.

notifyPlayerJoin.description: Send a Discord notification when a player joins.

notifyPlayerLeave.description: Send a Discord notification when a player leaves.

notifyBan.description: Send a Discord notification for permanent bans (including IP bans).

notifyTempban.description: Send a Discord notification for temporary bans.

notifyMute.description: Send a Discord notification for permanent mutes.

notifyTempmute.description: Send a Discord notification for temporary mutes.

notifyWarn.description: Send a Discord notification for warnings.

notifyJail.description: Send a Discord notification for jail punishments.

notifyPunishmentRevoked.description: Send a Discord notification when a punishment is revoked (unban, unmute, unjail).

notifyRestartScheduled.description: Send a Discord notification when a restart sequence is scheduled.

notifyRestartCancelled.description: Send a Discord notification when a scheduled restart is cancelled.

notifyRestartCountdown.description: Send a Discord notification for each restart countdown warning. Can be noisy.

notifyRestartImminent.description: Send a Discord notification immediately before the server restarts.

outboundQueueSize.description: Maximum number of queued outbound Discord messages. Further messages are dropped rather than blocking the server.

useEmbeds.description: Render notification messages as simple Discord embeds instead of plain messages. Chat relay always uses plain messages.

useAnsiColors.description: Render notifications and relayed player chat as colorized text in a Discord code block, matching the console channel's look. Discord does not parse @mentions inside code blocks, so turning this on means allowDiscordMentions stops actually pinging anyone in chat.

shutdownFlushMillis.description: How long shutdown waits for queued Discord messages to flush, in milliseconds. Kept well below the 30s shutdown watchdog.

countdownAnnounceSeconds.description: Only restart countdown warnings at or below this many seconds are sent to Discord.

consoleChannelId.description: Channel ID for the console channel. Empty disables it entirely; unlike the other channels this never falls back, so an unset ID can never leak console output or accept commands.

notifyConsoleLog.description: Relay server console/log output into the console channel.

consoleLogMinimumLevel.description: Lowest log level relayed to the console channel: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR. INFO matches what the server console shows by default; raise it only to cut down on noise.

consoleLogFlushSeconds.description: How often buffered console lines are flushed to Discord, in seconds.

consoleLogIgnoredPatterns.description: Regular expressions. Log lines matching any of these are never relayed to the console channel.

allowConsoleCommands.description: Let messages posted in the console channel run as server console commands. Anyone who can post in that channel can run commands; use Discord's own channel permissions to restrict who that is.
